scope: Spherical candidate fit evaluation, not catalogue adoption or native rendering qualification.
geometry: Same0.48 radius sphere, original head center and width. Body/clothing/arms/legs and source material palettes preserved.
findings: Whole-body proportions remain consistent with the cartoon direction; no body scaling warranted.
Short beard, mustache, patch and goatee retain their intended front coverage. No new posterior beard coverage was added.
Long beard remains the original angular sculpted style; sphere fit is not a new long-beard design.

Pashmina lower neck wrap intersected the fuller head; a smooth local downward ease corrects it without contracting the upper hood or chest tails. Minimum sampled head clearance0.008633 after correction.
Smile was faintest on deep skin at48px. Small even tube expansion0.0004 plus outward support0.0003 improves stroke continuity while preserving its path/colors.
Four eyes retain the approved glossy styling.48px is more constrained;64px shows lashes and mouth more clearly.
limits: Three hairstyles per build; selected existing tops, bottoms, cap/pashmina and glasses. Not a full catalogue conversion.
No phone performance measurements or new native renderer implementation.
No production profile-byte or handoff264 changes.
If sphere is adopted, portrait color and matching depth maps must be regenerated together.
